fact: The 2026 State Budget (OGE) allocates 62.7 billion kwanzas to implementing the Rede Nacional de Banda Larga, and Despacho Presidencial 394/26 (signed 14 October 2026) authorises about US$50 million to extend broadband to unserved areas.
title: PR autoriza 50 milhões USD para levar banda larga a zonas sem cobertura, mas OGE prevê 67 milhões
